stories.title: Persist and enforce configurable workflows
stories.scope: Extend Go authority and persistence for board-specific lanes, labels and transitions, retaining existing boards.
acceptance: Initialize and reopen distinct synthetic board workflows, including Blocked and Needs Terry; stable lane IDs survive label rename. Invalid/duplicate policy or unsupported transitions refuse atomically.

stories.title: Read useful card details and committed history
stories.scope: Deliver a readable card drawer and targeted CLI inspection with trustworthy committed history.
acceptance: Show ticket/title, description, state, priority, owner, relationship summaries and attributed/timestamped comments/history. Use safe readable text/formatting and clear empty/error states.
Browse bounded history/comments using the accepted contract; distinguish committed facts from private drafts/pending originals. Older history remains reachable without fabricated completeness.
Switch cards/boards while reads are delayed; stale responses cannot paint another drawer or expose private work. Preserve selection, draft and focus through refresh/reconnect.
Actual CLI focused and structured output agrees with normal browser committed facts; cross-board access and failure cases use synthetic data.

stories.title: Archive and restore cards without losing work
stories.scope: Archive/unarchive through browser and CLI while preserving card identity and committed evidence.
acceptance: Archive hides cards from ordinary lane/search/Attention views; explicit archived listing and focused inspection find them. Unarchive restores the same card and recorded lane, not a new ticket.

Preserve comments/history, parent/child and typed links, owner/priority, existing attachment references and human-controlled Completed semantics. No delete, garbage collection or attachment feature expansion.
Handle stale revision, unavailable board and unknown outcomes without retry or duplicate audit. Archived work remains represented according to .01 dependency rules.
Exercise restart, truthful workspace activity/counts and supported backup/export/restore round trip with actual product commands.

stories.title: Complete keyboard and focus journeys
stories.scope: Join all daily-work controls into a usable keyboard journey and independently inspect browser usability.
acceptance: Use keyboard-only create/open/read/edit/comment, rename, move, priority/owner, search/filter, hierarchy/link, archive/unarchive and human review; named controls and visible focus remain usable.
Enter/Space activate once; Escape and composing text do not submit or close unrelated work. Closing the drawer restores its opener or a documented search fallback.
Refresh/reordering, two windows and board navigation preserve the correct input, selection, scroll and focus; no drag-only required action.
Fresh non-author UX prewalk uses ordinary DOM/browser controls and records actionable findings. Fix/re-review material issues before handoff; no whole-product accessibility certification.
